name: octaweave_list_events
description: List events in a time window. `from`/`to` are RFC-3339. Recurring series are EXPANDED across the window, so an item you get back may not be a stored row: it carries series_id, recurrence_id, and is_override. Use the recurrence_id when editing one occurrence of a series.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

calendar.description: Optional calendar id or slug to restrict to.
